author: Michael Parker
text: My experience with T&J Excavating was a great experience. Trev and team communicated well and the project was completed timely and on budget. I will use them again on my next project!

author: William Drittler
text: T&J Excavating built my RV park and retention pond (roads, pads, septic systems, drainage etc) and did a stellar job!  They know what they are doing and pay attention to the minor details that are so often overlooked.   We highly recommend Trev and his team for your project!  William Drittler, owner of Candy Creek RV Park

author: khristi no
text: Trev and his crew are professional, knowledgeable patient and kind. Great resource for understanding what should be done to pass inspection and have a quality and lasting job. The weather worked against us, but as soon as possible his crew was ready to go, even circling back to touch up the pad after other contractors finished. We would recommend T&J without hesitation, and have already done so! They have the equipment and personnel to do whatever is needed.

author: charlene mason
text: I am so happy I called Trev and his crew to come out and do the projects I needed done. They were very professional and patient in explaining their processes to me. I felt confident that they knew exactly what they were doing. They were wonderful about making sure they cleaned up and had everything just right before they would leave each day.  I will definitely contact them again if I need any projects done in the future.

author: Eden Goble
text: Trev at T&J is an excellent contractor.  He helped me develop a 15 acre section of land that was not easy.  His ability to read the land and carve out the property was amazing.  He was on budget, on time and always available to answer questions.  I would highly recommend T&J for any site development project.
